steps.title: Write approved plan and progress tracker
steps.notes: Plan approved by user; tracking files created.

steps.title: Add Hono service, server-side @immich/sdk client, configuration, and authentication
steps.notes: Hono app on @hono/node-server with the server-side @immich/sdk 3.3.0-rc.0 client, environment/secret loading, Basic auth, JSON body limits, same-origin checks, security headers, and error-to-status mapping.

steps.title: Add date/album search and asset metadata access
steps.notes: Date/album search uses stable nested filters and cursor pagination from the supplied Immich OpenAPI spec.

steps.title: Add the selected fixed compression profiles and candidate size comparison
steps.notes: Fixed image profiles implemented; candidates must be strictly smaller. Live Photo video links are preserved and verified.

steps.title: Upload, copy and verify tags/albums, and optionally delete originals
steps.notes: Upload, tag/album assignment, checksum and metadata verification precede optional non-force deletion; default is keep.

steps.title: Add search, selection, comparison, progress, and apply UI flows
steps.notes: React SPA (Vite) with search, grid, profile selection, run controls, compare list, and batch review. Multi-profile runs optimize all selected images up front, three concurrently, then compare them one decision at a time with the smallest candidate highlighted; single-profile runs show a batch table with explicit apply. Stable React keys keep thumbnails attached across polls.

steps.title: Add a web Docker target and deployment instructions while preserving the proxy target
steps.notes: Shared-toolchain web Docker target and deployment documentation are written; Docker image was not built.

steps.title: Add monthly library endpoints: counts, month listing, trash, archive
steps.notes: Per-month capture counts come from one calendar-heatmap request; a month listing paginates internally, widens the UTC range and filters by local capture month, and is capped at 3000 assets. Trash uses a non-forced delete, archive sets visibility, and both validate UUID lists against a 500 id limit.

steps.title: Two-tab shell with Tailwind CSS v4 and shadcn/ui
steps.notes: The SPA moved to Tailwind v4 plus shadcn/ui (new-york/radix registry) with components.json, an @/* alias and generated components/ui. The compress tab was rewritten against the same components; the hand-written stylesheet was removed.

steps.title: Monthly cleanup flow: year grid, burst groups, per-asset actions
steps.notes: Year grid with counts; month view loads thumbnails only and splits same-minute bursts with a suggested keeper. Left click keeps, right click trashes, each burst group has an action bar, ungrouped assets get per-asset compress/trash/archive buttons, a profile selector drives compression, and every action confirms first. Compression reuses the existing batch pipeline with delete-original on.

steps.title: Order the month oldest first with bursts and singles interleaved
steps.notes: The month listing returns ascending capture order and the client builds one timeline of burst blocks and single grids, so a month reads from the 1st onwards.

steps.title: Non-blocking FIFO job queue for library actions
steps.notes: Server-side in-memory queue runs compress/trash/archive jobs one at a time, waits for the single optimizer slot instead of failing, isolates each failure, caps history at 200 jobs, and lets a still-queued job be cancelled. The UI polls the queue, disables assets with a pending job, and no longer blocks on a job.

steps.title: Tag compressed replacements as optimized and surface that in the month view
steps.notes: The replacement is tagged `optimized` (upserted by name) and verified with the copied tags before any deletion; the month listing marks tagged assets via SearchFilter.tagIds and tiles show an optimized badge.

steps.title: Live photo tab: unlink and trash paired motion videos
steps.notes: New tab lists stills that still reference a motion video (SearchFilter.isMotion, guarded by livePhotoVideoId) with load-more paging. Unlinking uses PUT /assets/{id} with livePhotoVideoId null and only trashes the video after Immich confirms the link is gone. An optional flag then compresses each unlinked still with bestProfileFor (AVIF per source family), grouped per profile and run through the existing batch pipeline once the videos are gone. Motion links are validated (different id, untrashed video asset) before anything is unlinked or trashed, replacements must be readable back with the exact uploaded size before an original is removed, and an interrupted compression is reported as still applying rather than failed. Selection supports click, shift-click ranges, drag-box marquee, Cmd/Ctrl+A and Esc, and photos with a queued job are excluded from every selection path.

steps.title: Publish the web image from GitHub Actions
steps.notes: Every push to web-ui builds the web target and pushes it to GHCR as <repo>-web, tagged latest and the full commit hash, with a gha layer cache and cancel-in-progress concurrency. actionlint clean; two runs on web-ui completed successfully and ghcr.io/matyifkbt/immich-upload-optimizer-web:latest resolves anonymously as a single-platform OCI manifest.

steps.title: Harden the destructive paths after a partial-failure report
steps.notes: Motion links are validated (different id, untrashed video) before unlinking or trashing, a replacement must be readable back from Immich with exactly the uploaded byte count before any original is removed, and a compression run that is still applying is reported as such instead of failed. Note the upstream release.yaml still pins action versions whose runners GitHub has removed.

steps.title: Hide queued assets from the month view immediately
steps.notes: The cleanup tab drops the assets of an archive, trash, or compression job from the grid the moment the job is queued and puts back anything the job did not settle, so the month only shows unhandled assets.

steps.title: Operator-defined tag-and-archive buttons from EXTRA_BUTTONS
steps.notes: EXTRA_BUTTONS parses comma-separated label:lucide-icon pairs at startup, exposes them through GET /api/config, and queues a tagArchive job that tags each asset with its label and only archives after Immich confirms the tag count. The server rejects any tag that no configured button declares.

steps.title: Open an asset in Immich from its thumbnail
steps.notes: Month view thumbnails link to https://my.immich.app/photos/<id>, the link helper that redirects to the user's own instance; marking stays on the Keep and Trash buttons and the desktop right click.

steps.title: Recognized faces under each asset in the month view
steps.notes: The month listing requests withPeople, keeps named visible people, and each tile shows up to four face thumbnails served through the new /api/people/{id}/thumbnail proxy, each linking to https://my.immich.app/people/<id>. Requires the person.read permission.

steps.title: Allow disabling the built-in HTTP Basic auth
steps.notes: WEB_AUTH_DISABLED=true skips the Basic-auth middleware and the password requirement so a proxy (Pocket ID behind oauth2-proxy, Authelia, forward auth) can authenticate callers. Only true/false are accepted; the flag is reported through GET /api/config and as a header banner, and main() logs a warning that every request is unauthenticated. Cross-origin write checks still apply.

steps.title: User runs build, tests, and deployment verification
steps.notes: Hono server and Vite SPA typecheck and build cleanly; the workflow passes actionlint. No runtime smoke test, no Docker image build and no live-Immich verification was performed by the assistant; that validation is the user's, including for the optimistic month actions, EXTRA_BUTTONS, click-to-open, the face row, and the unauthenticated mode.
